name: Wrecker II, The Wreckening
detailed_description:
Four hundred years in the future, humanity has colonized the exoplanet named SACH-041840 which orbits Proxima Centauri.  The colony struggled at first, but over the course of 50 years became self-sufficient and profitable.

But in the 55th year after colonization, "they" came;  Alien creatures that emerged from the ground and attacked the colony.  No one knows who or what controls them (if anything), but what is known is that if they reach the colony proper, it will be annihilated.

It is now the 149th year after colonization.

Outside the colony, dozens of battle turrets create a perimeter that defends the colony.  You are a member of the specially trained fighters operating independently, alone, one per turret.  You and your fellow turret operators are the lone defenders of the colony. 

WRECKER

Bring the Mayhem!  Use powerful weapons to destroy the aliens and watch your explosions chain into insanity!

#gif here

DAY TIME

During the day, repair your turret and drive around the landscape gathering resources to keep going!

#gif here

NIGHT TIME

When night falls, the aliens emerge and swarm your turret.  Face them head on and try to survive another day.  You are the colony's only hope!

#gif here

MODULATORS

Locate modulators, supplies, and upgrades. delivered from the colony and return them back to base for new upgrades!  Find and collect fuel and other resources from around the turret.  But be back in time for nightfall!

#gif here
